cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Thank you for apologising for missing my concert. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Closer. Now why did I have to ask whether you'd noticed missing it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know what to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for letting me rehearse your apology alone all week.
